hypothesis: A design-only materialization plan can specify how to convert contour-aware candidate rows into policy-side target artifacts before any optimizer is built.

implementation objective update training PPO promotion private holdout and self-ID claims remain blocked

decision_rule: M1621 passes if it designs traceable policy target materialization while keeping objective update and training blocked.
